title: What do LLMs say ChartHop is? — identity test comparison
note: Independent of the 38-query Google AI Overview collect. Answer text was obtained via DataForSEO LLM Responses Live, not inferred from AIO citation domains.

brand_baseline_summary.intended_buyers: HR and Finance teams; people/analytics leaders; small business to large enterprise / mid-market to enterprise
capabilities: living model of people + business data
HRIS, headcount planning, compensation, performance, engagement, goals, analytics
integrations with existing HRIS/ATS/FP&A (ADP, Greenhouse, Workday, SAP, etc.)
brand_baseline_summary.positioning_notes: Primary slogan/category on homepage/about is organizational intelligence; llms.txt alternatively leads with AI-powered people ops / people analytics + headcount planning. Exact slogan match is not required for semantic alignment.

limits_observed: Gemini rejects web_search_country_iso_code (40501); works with web_search true alone.
Promptwatch get_more_tools offered no one-off LLM snapshot tools.
No native Grok/xAI LLM Responses endpoint in DataForSEO LLM Responses family (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity only).
user_prompt limited to 500 characters on these endpoints.
Live tasks may take up to ~120s; concurrent Live capped at 30/account/platform per docs.
